title: Polynomial learner failure probability
statement: Let $n\ge0$, let $f\colon\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, let $P\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, let $z\colon P\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $k\ge0$. Suppose the algebraic degree over $\mathbb{F}_2$ of the Boolean function obtained by restricting $f$ according to $z$ and encoding it on the remaining coordinates is at most the prescribed polynomial degree. For any rational failure parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\le1/2$, the probability that the low-degree polynomial learner fails to recover that restricted function exactly, when supplied the prescribed uniformly sampled batch, is at most $\delta/4$.
